name: visual-input boundary evidence audit
question: Can independently identified visual afferents in the pinned MaleCNS traced parent justify expanding or replacing the three-cell input boundary to the selected 107 right KCg-d cells?
why_next: B5.1 found 48 of 107 KCs without a selected visual-parent pair and grossly weak effective drive in most contacted KCs; numerical gain changes would not identify omitted afferents.

hypothesis_outcomes.supported_expansion: Source-identified, traced direct parents with defensible independent visual identity contact at least one of the 48 currently unreached KCs; report their exact coverage and evidence, without installing them.
hypothesis_outcomes.no_supported_expansion: No such independently supportable parent exists in the pinned traced source; the current boundary remains incomplete or other transfer assumptions require independent investigation.
hypothesis_outcomes.inconclusive: Putative parents exist but exact MaleCNS identity, direct KC contact, or visual origin cannot be resolved from source and primary literature.

intervention: Read-only join of all traced direct parents of the selected 107 KCg-d_R bodies to MaleCNS neuron annotations and source-row contacts; independent primary-literature/cross-dataset identity review for visual candidate classes.
controls: MaleCNS v1.0 traced parent file SHA-256 values from validation receipt
same three B5 visual source IDs
no source-row exclusion by contact strength
primary_endpoint: For each evidence-qualified visual parent class/source-ID set, number and IDs of formerly unreached KCs with direct source contact, plus total direct KC coverage relative to 59/107; separate annotation evidence from inferred visual role.
secondary_endpoints: all-parent pair/contact counts and class distributions
visual candidate contact and convergence distributions
source row ledger and crosswalk provenance
unresolved cell identities or ROI ambiguity
predeclared_interpretation: Supported expansion requires an exact MaleCNS source ID, traced direct KC pair, independently defensible visual origin/class evidence, and at least one newly reached KC. Contact count alone, transmitter alone, or B5 spike rescue cannot qualify a source. Ambiguous homology or visual tuning remains INCONCLUSIVE. This is an anatomy/evidence decision, not an electrical pass.
do_not: choose candidates by maximal KC coverage alone
set a current from contact counts
stop_condition: Decide whether a source-ID-level visual boundary revision is independently defensible; do not implement it or launch an electrical revalidation as part of this stage.
